title: CTC-based Non-autoregressive Speech Translation

layout.note: Three lettered panels side by side with letters centred underneath: (a) a narrow column of two framed encoder groups, (b) a narrow column of two layer frames, (c) the widest panel with two stacked grey distribution panels, two pink representation strips, a right-hand column (circled plus, Softmax, Layer Norm, yellow circles) and a dotted key box at the top right. Every panel flows upward.

lesson: Give each new block its own lettered zoom panel beside the base architecture, and teach a vector operation once as a small matrix picture (embedding circles times probability cells give a coloured circle) with a dotted key, so the main drawing can use those circles unlabelled.
